scope: Exact-work cross-support comparisons between RAS Hodgson palm-leaf witnesses and Cambridge paper witnesses, without assuming direct copy lineage.

source_control.ras: Cowell and Eggeling 1875 Hodgson catalogue, uploaded OCR/VL scan
source_control.cambridge: Cecil Bendall 1883 Cambridge Buddhist Sanskrit manuscript catalogue, Internet Archive/Pahar digitised text and PDF
source_control.rule: Explicit Bendall cross-reference to an RAS catalogue number raises work-identity confidence, but does not establish descent from the RAS physical witness.

pairs.explicit_cross_reference: Bendall: See R. A. S. Cat. No. 13
Bendall directs the work to R. A. S. Cat. No. 2
pairs.source_warning: Bendall's printed fractions should be checked against the page image before final quotation, although multiple digitised text surrogates support 13 1/2 x 6 1/2 in.

pairs.explicit_cross_reference: Bendall: See R. A. S. Cat. No. 46; both catalogues give twenty-five patalas

cambridge_witnesses.material_notes: Bound in coloured boards with designs; first leaf illustrated; pages bordered by red and green stripes.

pairs.set_level_result: Paper does not imply one replacement geometry. Within the same named work, early paper can retain an even more extreme long-narrow form while later paper can move into a broad page regime.

collection_context.cambridge_collection: Chiefly collected by Dr Daniel Wright and received at Cambridge from February 1873 to May 1876.
collection_context.institutional_copying_programme: Bendall states that on Cowell's suggestion Wright was initially asked to procure copies made to order from works extant in Nepal; specimen transcriptions became Add. 1042. Originals were subsequently found procurable.
collection_context.warning: Do not infer that every modern Cambridge paper manuscript was commissioned. Copy/procurement state must be established witness by witness.

aggregate_interpretation: Exact-work comparisons show multiple directions of geometric change: strong short-axis expansion, long-axis expansion with stable width, and persistence of extreme narrow paper forms. Paper is therefore best treated as changing manuscript format possibility space rather than determining a single replacement page geometry.
method_warning: All comparisons are work-level unless a direct exemplar/copy relation is independently established. Dimensions should be image-checked before publication quotation where OCR fractions are involved.
